parameters.query: INSERT INTO market_data (id, source, commodity, metric, value, unit, period, fetched_at) VALUES (gen_random_uuid(), '{{ $json.source }}', '{{ $json.commodity }}', '{{ $json.metric }}', {{ $json.value }}, '{{ $json.unit }}', '{{ $json.period }}', NOW()) ON CONFLICT (source, commodity, metric, period) DO UPDATE SET value = EXCLUDED.value, fetched_at = NOW();

INSERT INTO market_data (id, source, commodity, metric, value, unit, period, fetched_at) SELECT gen_random_uuid(), source, commodity, metric, value, unit, period, NOW() FROM market_data WHERE fetched_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' AND source LIKE '%(Toàn quốc)%' ON CONFLICT (source, commodity, metric, period) DO UPDATE SET fetched_at = EXCLUDED.fetched_at;

INSERT INTO notifications (id, type, title, body, created_at, is_read) VALUES (gen_random_uuid()::text, 'SYSTEM', 'Cảnh báo hệ thống', 'Dữ liệu toàn quốc gặp lỗi. Đã tự động dùng cache.', NOW(), false);
